Descrição da vaga

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Investment Director Climate Investor 2
description:
Climate Fund Managers B.V. (CFM) is a leading blended finance fund manager dedicated to securing a sustainable future by investing across global emerging markets. CFM has a long-term vision to structure cutting edge financing facilities around thematic areas of climate change mitigation and adaptation, including renewable energy, water and oceans, sustainable land use, and sustainable cities. CFM is established as a joint venture between the Dutch development bank FMO and Sanlam InfraWorks – part of the Sanlam Group of South Africa with offices in The Hague, Cape Town, Windhoek, Singapore and Bogota.

CFM is subject to supervision by the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (Autoriteit Financiële Markten or “AFM”) and/or the Dutch Central Bank (De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. or “DNB”) and is authorised to act as investment manager (beheerder ).

Job Purpose

We are seeking an Investment Director to strengthen our Investments and Asset Management team. This role will report to the Regional Head of Latin America and will be ideally based in Brazil (Sao Paulo (preferred) or Rio de Janeiro). The Investment Director will interface CFM divisions and offices.

As a leader in the sustainable finance sector and a pioneer in the renewable energy, water sanitation, oceans infrastructure and green hydrogen sectors, CFM is committed to driving positive environmental impact through strategic investments in climate-related projects. The Investment Director will play a pivotal role in originating and executing on our investment strategies, managing a portfolio of water sanitation, waste valorisation opportunities and oceans infrastructure assets, contributing to the transformation of the LatAm economy and the transition to a more sustainable future.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Management and execution of CI-2 / Climate Investor Two Fund Managers Investment and Fundraising Strategy: Originate investment opportunities that align with the fund’s climate objectives, with a particular emphasis on all themes relevant in the Brazilian market that are in alignment with the CI2 mandate primarily namely water sanitation, waste transformation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm, taking into consideration ESG factors and the potential for positive environmental impact.
  • Portfolio Management: Invest and manage a diverse portfolio of water and sanitation and oceans infrastructure assets with a focus on strategic projects to CFM in Brazil.
  • Due Diligence: Conduct thorough due diligence on potential investment opportunities, assessing financial viability, evaluating technology readiness, environmental sustainability, market potential and key risk factors, supported by the regional Latam team.
  • Deal Structuring: Collaborate with the broader investment team to structure deals, negotiate terms, and secure financing for water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm.
  • Risk Management: Monitor and mitigate risks associated with water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure investments, implementing strategies to preserve capital and maximize returns.
  • Impact Measurement: Maintain robust impact measurement frameworks to track and report on the environmental benefits of investments.
  • Stakeholder Relations: Foster strong relationships with project developers, partners, and stakeholders in the water, sanitation, and oceans infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Compliance: Ensure investments are compliant with all regulatory and ethical guidelines, staying up to date with relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Fundraising and growth opportunities: Identify and highlight opportunities to seek new capital investors that may align with CFM’s products and growth strategies and support any such initiatives as requested.
  • Team Management: Provide management, mentorship, and guidance to junior investment professionals, promoting a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment as it may be relevant, while interacting closely with other Latam team members based in the region.
Qualifications and Experience
  • Chartered Accountant, CFA or Engineer with MBA or equivalent master’s degree.
  • A minimum of 15‑years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance with a strong track record in deal structuring and financial reporting in the Renewable Energy, Water, Waste to Energy and Oceans Infrastructure sector.
  • Strong analytical, communication and negotiation abilities.
  • English and Spanish language proficiency in addition to native Portuguese.
  • Proven ability to work across technical/financial and legal aspects of a transaction and work with various specialists internally and with government/shareholder/lender type stakeholders to provide transaction leadership.
  • Knowledge of relevant regulations and ESG Principles, compliance requirements, including but not limited to IFRS standards.
  • Ability to plan and prioritise effectively: strong project / process and team management skills.
  • Ability to apply sound business judgment and an analytical, pragmatic, and creative approach to problem solving.
  • Technically proficient (Advanced) in Excel, Word, PowerPoint essential.
  • Experience and significant proven track record of working in Brazil and other LatAm jurisdictions.
  • Work permit and residency in Brazil.
Behavioural Competencies
  • Result-oriented – Being focused on achieving objectives and results, persevering in the face of adversity.
  • Devotion to quality – Demanding a high quality on outputs and acting accordingly.
  • Planning – Systematically organizing activities and setting time frames, setting priorities.
  • Initiative – Identifying opportunities or solutions, and taking action.
  • Analysing and forming opinions – Being focused on examining matters in a systematic way.
  • Cooperation – Working with others in order to effectively contribute to a common objective.
  • Situational Awareness – Being well informed about developments in one's environment and effectively using this information for one's own organisation.
  • Performance under pressure – Maintaining an effective performance under pressure, or when faced with setbacks or disappointment.

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We believe in hiring for Carta first, focusing on your core strengths and technical craft rather than a specific team’s immediate gap.

Staff Engineers at Carta are technical anchors for our business. You don’t just own features, you take long‑term accountability for the technical health and strategic direction of different domains. As you move through our process, we’ll transition from the general pool to a team‑matching phase. Our goal is to match your unique technical strengths, and personal career interests with our most impactful, strategic challenges.

Strategic areas you may influence
  • Platform Data Ecosystem: Shaping how data flows across our entire suite of products to ensure a “single source of truth” for private market data.
  • Financial Systems Architecture: Designing resilient, scalable solutions for management fee accounting and multi‑currency transactions.
  • Engineering Excellence: Defining company‑wide standards that reduce operational load and improve developer velocity across dozens of teams.
The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Staff Engineer, you are responsible for the long‑term technical health and success of your business unit. You’ll work to:

  • Navigate Ambiguity: Tackle the most complex and poorly defined problems at Carta, breaking them down into navigable paths for the rest of the organization.
  • Champion Systemic Improvement: Identify and eliminate failure patterns across multiple systems, driving architectural changes that improve scalability and reliability.
  • Bridge Technical Gaps: Use your deep understanding of cross‑functional domains to align multiple teams on major technical decisions.
  • Define the AI Frontier: Lead the charge in transforming how we build by defining the context and building the rails that allow every person at Carta to leverage AI tools safely and effectively. You’ll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.
  • Uphold Engineering Standards: Set the vision for operational excellence and mentor senior engineers to raise the collective craft of the organization.
About You
  • The Tech Stack: You are an expert in building distributed systems. While our primary stack is Python/Django, React, and Postgres, you should be comfortable guiding technical direction across JVM languages, gRPC, and cloud‑native infrastructure (AWS).
  • Leadership: You lead through influence rather than authority, acting as a role model for constructive communication and technical discipline.
  • Vision: You don't just solve the problem in front of you; you anticipate future roadblocks and build systems that support long‑term business growth.
  • Experience: We recommend 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of high‑level technical leadership.
Disclosures
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

title: Senior Media Operations Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

Key responsibilities

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers.
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

The Senior Structural Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Structural (Eng) discipline within McDermott. description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Safety & Security

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament-wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk-informed decision-making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament-wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non-competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions
Your Profile Education
  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field
Experience
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi‑agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese
Certifications & Requirements
  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Job Purpose

The Senior People Operations Officer serves as the College’s principal operational administrator for all HR-, payroll-, and hiring-related transactions. This role ensures the accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of personnel actions for faculty, staff, adjuncts, student employees, wage workers, and stipend-supported personnel. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.
  • Coordinate all job posting requests with HR Recruiting and ensure funding alignment prior to submission.
  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.
  • Ensure accurate student hiring through FRFs, HAFs, wage-hire classifications, and Workday setup.
  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.
  • Conduct monthly HR and payroll compliance audits including cost allocations, active/inactive positions, and pending transactions.
  • Provide training and guidance to department administrators, chairs, and coordinators on Workday processes and personnel workflows.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for hiring, onboarding, terminations, PAPs, and Workday routing.
  • Liaise with HR, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost to resolve transactional issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Serve as subject‑matter expert for Workday HR and Workday Finance functionality relevant to personnel transactions.
  • Provide people‑data inputs to the Assistant Dean for reporting and planning (not financial analysis).
  • Manage confidential personnel information in accordance with University policies.
Core Competencies
  • Demonstrated ability to provide executive-level financial and operational guidance in a complex academic environment.
  • Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, accounting controls, and resource stewardship.
  • Ability to interpret policy, influence adoption, and lead change with diplomacy and clarity in evolving systems.
  • Ability to supervise, develop, mentor, and evaluate staff performance and ensure accountability.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex financial and operational issues clearly.
  • Skilled in Workday Financials, procurement systems, and advanced spreadsheet and reporting tools.
Minimum Requirements

  • Ability to run reports, analyze personnel data, and maintain accurate records.

ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL

Contexto e Descrição do Projeto

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio.

Descrição Resumida do Cargo

O/a Supervisor/a Operacional será responsável por atuar no acompanhamento e na organização das atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento do planejamento, dos prazos e dos procedimentos operacionais. A função é essencial para assegurar a qualidade da execução, o suporte à equipe operacional e o alinhamento das ações às diretrizes institucionais.

Responsabilidades
  • Supervisionar, orientar e apoiar a equipe de monitores no desempenho de suas atividades;

  • Organizar horários de trabalho, controlar a frequência e monitorar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Acompanhar e supervisionar as atividades operacionais da Exposição;
  • Garantir a qualidade do serviço prestado ao público e a experiência dos visitantes;

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women’s World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women’s Football Strategy .

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers.
  • Support engagement with local and international media to define requirements and ensure the delivery of operations is set to the highest standards.
  • Implementation of the Camera Loan & repair facilities and any new service.
YOUR PROFILE
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent
  • Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
  • 5+ years’ experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
  • 5-7 years’ experience in sports project management, preferably in football
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host City Manager - Brasília will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília.

Please apply only if you currently live in Brasília or can relocate there independently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments
    • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
    • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
    • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.
  2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables
    • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
    • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
    • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).
  3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure
    • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
    • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
    • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.
  4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance
    • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
    • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
    • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
    • Reporting and Governance
    • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.
YOUR PROFILE Education

Experience
  • Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.
  • Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).
Behavioral Competencies
  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.

Differentials

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

title: Head of Market Analysis
description:
Descrição da empresa

Com mais de 6 mil funcionários em mais de 20 países, a Statkraft é uma empresa norueguesa, com ações pautadas pela ética e transparência. É líder em energia hidrelétrica internacionalmente e a maior geradora de energia renovável da Europa. O grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, energia eólica, energia solar, energia a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis - SC e também escritórios comerciais em São Paulo - SP (Vila Olímpia) e Rio de Janeiro - RJ (Leblon). Atualmente, controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Em novembro de 2023, a Statkraft assinou a compra da Enerfín, subsidiária renovável da espanhola Elecnor, que inclui nove parques eólicos em operação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

Além disso, a empresa atua na comercialização de energia, a partir dos escritórios comerciais no Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP), com uma carteira de clientes comerciais e industriais de diversos segmentos.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção de sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

Descrição do emprego

Como Head of Market Analysis, você será responsável por conduzir análises e previsões de preços de energia, bem como pesquisas de mercado, com o objetivo de orientar decisões estratégicas de comercialização de energia e representar a área e reportar análises para clientes internos e externos.

Trabalhando como Head of Market Analysis você irá:

Apoiar ativamente a rentabilidade da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento de análises e previsões de preços de energia, acompanhando variáveis como precipitação, vazão, demanda, intercâmbio de energia entre subsistemas, entre outros, com o objetivo de orientar decisões de compra e venda de energia.

Garantir que as informações inseridas nos modelos de análise de preços estejam corretas, por meio de análise técnica dos pressupostos utilizados nos modelos do CEPEL, consultando relatórios e dados publicados, e realizando processamento de dados quando necessário.

Analisar criticamente os resultados, identificando possíveis desvios e lacunas nos modelos.

Fornecer informações relevantes com qualidade e agilidade sobre fatores que possam afetar variações no preço de mercado, monitorando negociações, notas técnicas e processos da ANEEL e ONS sobre temas regulatórios, através de pesquisas e acesso aos sites institucionais.

Apoiar a melhoria dos resultados de ativos no Brasil por meio do desenvolvimento de análises e previsões de preços de energia, acompanhando variáveis como chuvas, afluências, demanda e intercâmbio de energia entre subsistemas.

Reportar rapidamente e com transparência mudanças regulatórias e informações de preço ao front office e middle office que possam impactar decisões de mercado e avaliações de risco.

Estruturar análises e cenários de preços de forma oportuna, de acordo com a dinâmica dos negócios da Statkraft, garantindo que os recursos e pessoas necessários estejam disponíveis.

title: Reservoir Engineer - entry-level
description:
Job Summary

The Reservoir Engineer is responsible for assisting in delivery of safe, efficient, and reliable products and services to our customers. The job consults with operations groups as needed to support the area of expertise and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement of product and service delivery and formally communicates findings. The Reservoir Engineer actively participates in promoting new technology and services offerings and supports the PL in risk management and applying lessons learned to improve job design and execution as related to the area of expertise. They provide real-time support to operations as required.

Additional Responsibilities
  • Provide technical support in the area of expertise throughout the Sales and Product and Service Delivery process.
  • Assist as required with the development of technical job designs for PLs.
  • Assist with identifying areas where new and cost effective techniques can be applied.
  • Explore opportunities for value-added products and services.
  • Consult with Design/Technical Engineer role as required to optimize the technical design.
  • Assist in real-time incident response, recovery, and investigation as related to the area of expertise.
  • Assist in evaluating technical viability and overall appraisal of tenders as related to the area of expertise.
  • Remain current on new technologies.
  • Maintain customer visibility through active participation in professional society activities and calls for papers.
  • Understand the competition's technical offering.
  • Participate in external technical societies and communities.
  • Contribute, write and review technical publications.
  • Engage with local universities, Customer institutes and research organizations.
Requirements:
  • Academic Background: A bachelor's or master's degree in Petroleum Engineering, Reservoir Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Applied Mathematics or related field is expected.
  • Language: Intermediate/advanced English
  • Practical Experience: Previous experience in internships, research projects, or working in the oil and gas industry, especially in roles related to reservoir engineering and numerical simulation, would be highly valued.
  • Experience in Numerical Simulation: Proven experience in numerical simulation of reservoirs using specialized software such as Eclipse, Petrel or similar. This includes the ability to model the behavior of fluids in oil and gas reservoirs, simulate fluid flow in different scenarios, and interpret the results.
  • Knowledge of Programming Language: Strong proficiency in programming language, especially Python. This includes the ability to write scripts and programs to automate tasks, manipulate data, create analysis and visualization tools, and integrate different parts of the simulation workflow.
  • Knowledge in Geology and Reservoir Engineering: Solid understanding of the concepts of petroleum geology, reservoir engineering and oil recovery processes. This includes the ability to interpret geological and engineering data to create accurate reservoir models.
  • New energies and sustainability: desirable knowledge of numerical simulation applied to new energies and sustainability, such as carbon capture and storage.
Soft Skills:
  • Analytical and Problem Solving Skills: Ability to analyze complex problems related to reservoir engineering, identify effective solutions and implement them efficiently.
  • Communication and Teamwork: Verbal and written communication skills are crucial for communicating results, collaborating with teammates and presenting technical information in a clear and concise manner.
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning: Given the dynamic nature of the oil and gas industry and constant technological changes, it is important that the candidate demonstrates adaptability and willingness to continually learn new techniques and technologies.

São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Desenvolvimento de Projetos Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos de instalações voltadas ao transporte de gás natural.   • Desenvolver materiais e conduzir reuniões técnicas com clientes internos e externos.

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo. A Empodera está à procura de uma pessoa dinâmica, organizada e motivada para coordenar nosso time administrativo‑financeiro e trabalhar para o empoderamento e garantia de direitos de meninas e mulheres.

A coordenadora administrativa‑financeira pleno é responsável, juntamente com a gestão executiva, por analisar, gerenciar e implementar sistemas e processos administrativos e financeiros eficientes e transparentes na organização. Além disso, desenvolve processos integrados que aumentam a eficiência e a eficácia da organização, em um ambiente empreendedor e colaborativo.

A Empodera incentiva fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas negras, indígenas, pessoas vivendo com HIV/AIDS, pessoas LGBTI+ e com deficiência.

Quem somos

As ações da organização são focadas em promover a redução dos estereótipos nocivos e da violência baseados no gênero.
A Empodera trabalha com o desenvolvimento e execução de metodologias esportivas, treinamentos e suporte técnico de organizações em prol de uma sociedade mais justa e equânime.

Principais responsabilidades

    • Analisar e apresentar relatórios financeiros de maneira precisa e oportuna; comunicar claramente as demonstrações mensais e anuais

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8‑figure ARR, and is doubling year over year – with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify. We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We’re targeting 2× customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there. We’re capital‑efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion‑driven: make the signup‑to‑checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About The Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols. Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can’t optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built‑in quality check. You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role and join us?
  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company’s top‑line numbers every month.
  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols.
  • First 2 Quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort‑level experiment tracking.
  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.
What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)
  • Deliver protocol‑level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude.
  • Ship full‑stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React.
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations.
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR‑vs‑retention tension that comes with a dual mandate.
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations.
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on.
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort‑level M1 retention tracking per experiment.
  • Drive adoption of AI‑assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity.
Our Tech Stack
  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (strongly preferred)
  • Event‑sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux‑loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI‑assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding
What We Are Looking For (Qualifications)
  • You’ve led a team of 4‑8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained.
  • You’ve shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture).
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). JavaScript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade‑offs to a PM who wants to ship faster.
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features.
  • You’re comfortable with event‑sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams.
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team’s development process.
Nice To Have (strongly Preferred)
  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce.
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations.
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure.
How We Work
  • Remote, Americas‑based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones).
  • Two‑week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together.
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day.
World‑Class Benefits
  • Full suite: health, medical, dental coverage (USA & Canada).
  • Flexible vacation/time‑off policies.
  • Equity into the company in the form of high‑potential stock options.
  • Liquidity of options whenever available.
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees).
Interview process

Do you believe you’re a fit for this role and want to join the Maximus team? We’d love to hear about you! Here is what you can expect from the hiring process (if there are changes we will be sure to let you know).

  • Application & Criteria Questionnaire: When submitting your application and resume, tell us why you want to join Maximus and take your time with the questions. The Criteria Questionnaire will be sent to you automatically and is mandatory, we will use it as part of our data‑driven process. This is your chance to make a strong first impression.
  • First Interview (30min): Interview with Justin L, Recruiting Lead. This will be an exploratory conversation focused on how you work, your experience & fit for the role, and alignment on values and expectations.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (60min): You will then meet with Mark P – Head of Engineering to understand how you would approach real Growth team problems across system design and technical decisions as well as discussion around leading a team, growing engineers, hiring, AI adoption, and other aspects of people leadership.
  • Technical Interview (60min): Interview with one of our Senior or Lead engineers to evaluate hands‑on coding ability in our stack (Rails + React/TypeScript). We want to see that you can build and ship, not just architect. Feel free to use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) during the exercise, as appropriate.
  • Product Interview (45min): You will chat with Steve C – Senior Growth Product Manager who will dive into your collaboration with product, how you assess trade‑offs, and growth related product work.
  • Meet the CEO (30min): At the very end, you will have the opportunity to meet with Cam S, our CEO. This is a great chance for you to gain a deeper understanding of Maximus’s strategy, values, and work processes.

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note‑taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note‑takers for their own records if they wish.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry's transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world's trade is carried by sea?

We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services - together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonize the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsilä’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.

Main Responsibilities
  • Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.
  • Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.
  • Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.
  • Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.
  • Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.
  • Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.
  • Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.
Required Qualifications
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.
  • LL.M. degree required.
  • Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practicing attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English; ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.
  • Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.
  • Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.
  • Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.
  • Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.
What Success Looks Like In This Role
  • Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.
  • Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.
  • Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.
  • Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.
Why join us

You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.

Last application date: 17/04/2026

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.

Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Incumbent serves as a member of the president’s cabinet and senior management team with authority over a wide range of policy issues; organizational, management and technical assignments, and special projects that may be on-going or non-recurring in nature. The individual will also oversee the management of the staff assigned to the Office of the President and its unique functions.

Dimensions

Supervise the work of office staff, professionals, consultants and students. Manage and organize priority projects, initiatives, and workflow for the Office of the President.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include the Board of Trustees, President, executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university. External contacts include parents, consultants, auditors, government officials, representatives from financial institutions, investment managers, law firms, alumni, donors, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities
  • The Chief of Staff is responsible for overseeing and directing the operations of the President’s Office providing executive level support to the President serving as a senior advisor with regard to policy formulation, alternative and option analysis, and ensuring the decisions of the president are implemented in a timely manner and in accordance with direction given.
  • The Chief of staff represents the president’s position to internal and external stakeholders on matters of university policy and practice and serves as the president’s liaison to various University-related committees. The Chief of Staff also consistently interfaces with the President’s Cabinet to ensure that key issues are being proactively addressed.
  • The Chief of Staff will manage the flow of communication in and out of the President’s office to ensure consistent and responsive message delivery to key University stakeholders, including faculty, staff, students, alumni and other external constituents as appropriate.
  • Assist in planning (including strategic planning) and developing and establishing policies and goals consistent with organizational objectives and governmental regulations.
  • Generate, schedule, track, and coordinate assignments, as needed across stakeholder groups. Work independently to complete assignments involving the appropriate internal or external contacts.
  • Coordinate comprehensive projects and assignments that require collaboration of several different offices and/or areas of the University including personnel/management reviews, and special studies.
  • Prepare agendas for each Cabinet or other executive meetings and provide a summary of discussions and action items resulting from each meeting to attendees, ensuring appropriate follow-up as required.
  • Conduct data analysis, research, and write reports for use in executive decision-making. Handle data, communication and projects that are highly privileged and confidential.
  • Provide leadership in the development and administration of University or division-wide integrated plans and processes, i.e., accreditation assessments and performance evaluation reviews.
  • Build and maintain mutually supportive relationships with all levels of management, staff, outside agencies and vendors, when necessary. Work to remove barriers that hamper inter-and intra-department communications. Coordinate and monitor assignments which must be accomplished in conjunction with other senior executives.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.
Core Competencies
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the principles, practices and methods employed in senior and executive level management.
  • Keen and demonstrated understanding of higher education structures, systems, strategies, policies, and procedures.
  • Computer and Internet research skills (including Microsoft Office Suite; spreadsheet, and presentation)
  • Skill in management and leadership with the ability to direct programs, staff, and cross-functional teams in an efficient and effective manner.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skill including tact, patience, and acumen and the ability to work with many, diverse individuals across various functions.
  • Excellent organizational and analytical skill and ability to formulate recommendations.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills including correspondence writing, professional presentation development.
  • Ability to prioritize work follow-through with meticulous attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to use a great deal of initiative work effectively under pressure and handle multiple simultaneous tasks and demands.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious relations with students, faculty, staff, University officials and the general public.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment; and commitment to completing tasks to the highest standards.
  • Highest level of integrity and management of confidential information
Minimum Requirements

Master’s Degree in Business/Public Administration or related field, and 7 years of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of 10 years combined relevant training and experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $200,000 - $225,000

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos o Grupo OLX , um marketplace de classificados 100% digital que conecta mais de 7 milhões de pessoas .

Líder na compra e venda de produtos usados, autos e imóveis, nosso ecossistema diversificado oferece uma plataforma inovadora para negócios e consumo consciente.

São mais de 500 mil anúncios publicados diariamente e 70 milhões de visitas em nossas plataformas (OLX, VivaReal e Zap Imóveis) por mês. Com tecnologia desenvolvida no Brasil, democratizamos o acesso ao comércio para todos, gerando impacto positivo na economia e na vida das pessoas.

Ao trabalhar na OLX você fará parte de uma cultura de alta performance , com os melhores talentos do mercado. Juntos, alcançamos resultados excepcionais para o negócio e para as nossas pessoas, sempre com a melhor experiência.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é sua chance. Nessa posição de Pessoa Executiva de Negócios, você vai somar ao time do RJ que tem como objetivo Captação de novos clientes.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Responsável pela captação, atendimento e gestão de carteira de clientes;
  • Realizar pesquisas para entender o mercado alvo, identificar concorrentes e oportunidades;
  • Identificar e gerar leads qualificados por meio de PAP, Visitas presenciais, pesquisas, redes sociais, eventos, parcerias etc;
  • Realizar visitas presenciais, PAP, chamadas telefônicas, enviar e-mails ou mensagens para iniciar o contato com leads potenciais;
  • Preparar e realizar apresentações de vendas para prospects, destacando os benefícios dos produtos ou serviços;
  • Manter um acompanhamento constante com leads, responder a dúvidas e fornecer informações adicionais conforme necessário;
  • Utilizar eficientemente ferramentas de CRM e outras tecnologias de vendas para gerenciar leads, agendar compromissos e acompanhar o progresso;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de planejamento para alinhar estratégias e compartilhar informações importantes;
  • Manter registros precisos e atualizados de todas as interações com leads e clientes no sistema de CRM;
  • Participar de treinamentos e workshops para aprimorar habilidades de vendas e manter-se atualizado sobre produtos e serviços;
  • Análise do desempenho dos clientes, interação com os times técnicos, marketing e conteúdo para ações de relacionamento.
Requisitos e qualificações

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Perfil comercial para captação de clientes, Visitas presenciais, abordagem ativa, PAP
  • Disponibilidades para viagens de carro, ônibus ou avião, de acordo com a região de atuação;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e outras tecnologias de vendas.
  • Conhecimento intermediários do pacote office e ferramentas do Google
  • Disposição para se adaptar a mudanças nas estratégias de vendas ou no mercado.
  • Flexibilidade para lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes.
  • Habilidade para construir e manter relacionamentos positivos com clientes potenciais.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente em equipe.
  • Iniciativa para buscar ativamente novos leads e oportunidades de negócio.
  • Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas de forma independente.
Informações adicionais

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

  • Auxílio Home Office

  • Licenças estendidas
  • Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em regime de escala.

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação.

title: Analista de Governança
description:
Sobre nós:

A MDC tem como propósito fazer da energia sustentável uma geradora de valor.

Investimos em ativos energéticos com presença em toda a cadeia de gás natural, biometano, energia elétrica renovável e vapor através de biomassa. Oferecemos soluções energéticas para negócios que almejam uma economia de baixo carbono, proporcionando estabilidade e valor sustentável a longo prazo.

Conheça um pouco da nossa empresa em 

Queremos sempre fazer mais e melhor, com segurança e com pessoas engajadas que não desistem dos desafios. Chegamos até aqui com muito esforço e trabalho em equipe. Dedicamos nossa energia para desenvolver negócios sustentáveis. Agimos como donos e estimulamos a inovação.

Buscamos criar um ambiente inclusivo, justo, seguro e respeitoso para todos, onde cada colaborador tenha acesso às mesmas oportunidades de desenvolvimento. Em nossa Companhia, não aceitamos discriminação ou preconceito, sejam eles de gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, raça, nacionalidade, condição física ou quaisquer outros. Valorizamos nossa gente, nossa diversidade, fortalecendo o time. Criamos espaços para autenticidade.

Sobre a vaga: 

ANALISTA DE GOVERNANÇA

Prestar suporte às atividades de governança corporativa e rotinas societárias da Companhia, incluindo a organização de reuniões da Diretoria, Conselho de Administração e Assembleias, elaboração e controle de atas e documentos societários, gestão e controle de procurações, bem como a administração e atualização do portal e dos repositórios de documentos do departamento Jurídico.

Principais atribuições/responsabilidades:

  • Organizar agendas, pautas e materiais das reuniões da Diretoria, Conselho de Administração e Assembleias;
  • Elaborar convocações, agendas e pautas de reuniões dos órgãos de governança;
  • Atuar como secretário(a) de reuniões, elaborar atas, listas de presença, registros de deliberações e consolidar materiais das áreas para composição dos books de reunião;                              
  • Controlar o calendário anual de governança;
  • Acompanhar as deliberações e encaminhar as decisões às áreas responsáveis;
  • Preparar minutas de atas, acompanhar coleta de assinaturas e formalização de documentos societários;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração e conferência de atos societários, contratos sociais, procurações e documentos corporativos;
  • Organizar e manter atualizada a base documental societária da companhia;                    
  • Controlar o arquivamento físico e digital de documentos jurídicos e societários;      
  • Atualizar sistemas jurídicos, bases documentais e planilhas de controle societário;                    
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas no fornecimento de documentos societários;                         
  • Participar de processos de due diligence;                                                     
  • Realizar pesquisas em legislação, doutrina e jurisprudência;
  • Manter interface com cartórios, Juntas Comerciais, escritórios de advocacia, contabilidade e prestadores de serviços paralegais.

Requisitos:

  • Superior em Direito, Administração, Secretariado Executivo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia consistente em secretariado de órgãos de governança, suporte societário ou funções paralegais, com pelo menos 4 anos de atuação;

title: Tecnico de manutencão elétrica jr
description:
Um aeroporto com a alma carioca!

O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do Estado. Ao longo de 10 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

Nosso Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser abraça a diversidade, por isso, nossos processos seletivos são abertos à todos, afinal trabalhamos todos os dias para a verdadeira conexão.

Se você se identifica com esses valores e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e que adora desafios, temos uma oportunidade como Técnico de Manutenção Elétrica Jr.  

Nesse desafio você atuará na fiscalização e acompanhamento de manutenções em sistemas elétricos, acompanhamento de planos de preventivas e gestão de equipe terceirizada.

Esse desafio requer que você desempenhe as seguintes atividades:

  • Prestar apoio às atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos sistemas eletrônicos, adotando as medidas necessárias para assegurar sua integridade, desempenho e conservação;

  • Efetuar solicitações de materiais e serviços para garantir a realização das atividades no prazo determinado;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e demais documentos pertinentes às ocorrências identificadas e intervenções realizadas, de forma clara e precisa;
  • Realizar atividades de acordo com o Plano de Manutenção, a fim de eliminar/reduzir o número de ocorrências de não operacionalidades.

Habilidades e qualificações necessárias:

  • Ensino Técnico em Eletrotécnica; 
  • Domínio do Pacote Office;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Ser responsável, organizado, proativo, objetivo e comprometido;

title: Auxiliar de operador de sistemas remotos i rio de janeiro (presencial)

Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.

title: Comandante a330
description:
Não pode faltar em sua bagagem:


Formação


  • Ensino Médio completo (Ensino Superior é um diferencial)


Experiência


  • Experiência superior a 5 anos na função e na aeronave.


Certificações Obrigatórias


  • Licença de Piloto de Linha Aérea (PLA);
  • Certificado de Habilitação Técnica (CHT) para o Airbus A330;
  • Certificado Médico Aeronáutico (CMA) válido;
  • Passaporte brasileiro válido por mais de 6 (seis) meses;
  • Vistos americanos B1, B2 e D válidos.


Conhecimentos Técnicos


  • Regulamentação aeronáutica aplicável (RBAC 121 e CBA);
  • Sistema de Gerenciamento de Segurança Operacional (SGSO);
  • Procedimentos operacionais da aeronave A330;
  • Operação de aeronaves widebody e voos de longo curso.


Idiomas


  • Proficiência na língua inglesa (ICAO) 4 ou superior.


IMPORTANTE: o local de trabalho será definido após a aprovação no processo seletivo. É necessário possuir disponibilidade para mudança.

Missão do Cargo


Exercer a autoridade de Comandante desde a apresentação para o voo até a entrega da aeronave ao final da viagem, garantindo a Segurança operacional, a conformidade regulatória e a continuidade das operações e representando a empresa perante passageiros, tripulação e autoridades, em alinhamento ao Código Brasileiro de Aeronáutica (CBA) e aos regulamentos vigentes.


Além disso, atuar em integração com os Times da Companhia, contribuindo com sua experiência para o fortalecimento contínuo da operação.


Autoridade


  • Exercer autoridade plena sobre a aeronave, tripulação, passageiros e carga durante toda a operação;
  • Recusar aeronave que não esteja em condições aeronavegáveis;
  • Adiar, suspender ou encerrar o voo quando indispensável à Segurança;
  • Recusar embarque ou determinar desembarque de pessoas que comprometam a Segurança ou a disciplina a bordo;
  • Adotar medidas necessárias à proteção da aeronave, das pessoas e dos bens transportados;
  • Representar o Administrador da empresa durante toda a viagem;
  • Atuar em ocorrências relacionadas a atos ilícitos (AVSEC), mantendo comunicação com os órgãos de controle;
  • Contratar manutenção extraordinária, quando necessário;
  • Validar licenças e certificados, conforme prerrogativa da autoridade aeronáutica.



Segurança Operacional


  • Garantir a Segurança de tripulantes, passageiros e carga do fechamento das portas até o desembarque final;
  • Assegurar as condições de aeronavegabilidade, peso e balanceamento;
  • Certificar-se da correta quantidade de combustível e monitorar seu consumo;
  • Avaliar as condições meteorológicas, NOTAMs e dos aeródromos;
  • Garantir que o voo esteja devidamente despachado junto ao DOV.;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos do Programa de Segurança do Operador Aéreo;
  • Reportar condições inseguras aos órgãos de controle e à área de Safety;
  • Identificar e reportar perigos operacionais por meio do sistema oficial da empresa.


Gestão da Tripulação


  • Assegurar a subordinação técnica e disciplinar da tripulação;
  • Delegar atribuições, exceto aquelas relacionadas à Segurança do voo;
  • Definir o Pilot Flying e garantir a execução correta dos checklists;
  • Garantir que apenas atividades essenciais sejam realizadas em fases críticas do voo;
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento da regulamentação profissional, incluindo jornada, repouso e limites operacionais.


Conformidade e Registros


  • Preencher ou assegurar o correto preenchimento do Diário de Bordo e do Relatório Técnico da Aeronave;

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Infraestrutura para atuar de forma estratégica na governança e nos processos de TI, apoiando a condução e o controle de projetos em contextos ágeis e preditivos, garantindo alinhamento com as diretrizes corporativas, qualidade das entregas e previsibilidade de resultados.

Como será o dia a dia:
